answer: Anti-Sybil via river-timed live probes: each identity publishes a quartz challenge socket. Random established auditors fire short onyx-sealed nonces at secret offsets; only a warm process holding that key can return a keyed MAC over nonce plus boot id. Peers drop duplicate host fingerprints and late replies. Extra identities need separate always-on responders—one shared bot cannot cover staggered offsets. Limitation: rented fleets still work, but cost scales per clone and idle clones miss their river window.
